## Grounding

hospitality venues (journey mapping, immersive experience design,
service-touchpoint design). **Worked example** cited by reference,
never re-derived: legacy formation `HOS-01` ("Hospitality, espaces
créatifs et expérience immersive," `backend/seed_data.py:964-976`,
44h, badge "Creative Hospitality Manager"), specifically module
`HOS-01-M03` ("Design d'expérience immersive caribéenne,"
`backend/seed_modules.py`) — deliverable "Journey map + scénographie."
This formation specializes on that legacy survey depth — legacy
`HOS-01` stays exactly as delivered, untouched, cited only. Per the
corpus's own code-collision discipline, this row's internal document
code is `HOS-02` (a Master 2D candidate row), never confused with the
